name: 生成图片
description: 仅在用户明确要求最终图片时调用。使用员工配置的 image_model_id 通过图片专用 API 生成并返回可展示的图片 URL；不要用思考模型冒充生图模型。
inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"prompt":{"type":"string","description":"完整、可直接生图的正向提示词"},"size":{"type":"string","enum":["1024x1024","1024x1536","1536x1024"],"default":"1024x1536"},"quality":{"type":"string","enum":["low","medium","high","auto"],"default":"medium"}},"required":["prompt"]}
